title: 🔆🔅General Abolfazl Shekarchi, Iran's Armed Forces Spokesperson remarks.
text:
🔆🔅General Abolfazl Shekarchi, Iran's Armed Forces Spokesperson remarks."

"=============="

"Abolfazl Shekarchi, Iran's Armed Forces Spokesperson: "Today, in this part of the work, namely the media war, we are facing the media empire of global arrogance, and all the new tools and modern media technologies of today are at the disposal of our enemies. A vast amount of material investment has been made in this narrative worldwide; however, because the other side is under the umbrella of Satan and the media work of the Islamic Revolution and the Islamic Republic is under the umbrella of the grace of Almighty God, it will prevail.""

"Abolfazl Shekarchi, Iran's Armed Forces Spokesperson: "In terms of tools, capabilities, and sophisticated and modern technologies in the field of media, the enemy is not comparable to our capabilities at all. It is the same in terms of credibility and support. Today, we must say that the media empire we are referring to has its center of gravity in the hands of the Zionists.""

"Abolfazl Shekarchi, Iran's Armed Forces Spokesperson: "Today, when you look at the BBC, when you look at Iran International, at Manoto, at Radio Farda—when you look at these hostile, violent, and warmongering media outlets of the world—you see directly that they are connected to the Mossad or the CIA; they receive support and take operational orders.""

"SOT 4, Abolfazl Shekarchi, Iran's Armed Forces Spokesperson: "Of course, we do not view these outlets as media. We in the Armed Forces view those working for, for example, Iran International, BBC, Manoto, and Radio Farda as Zionist soldiers—soldiers of the criminal America. We do not view them as media in any way. Therefore, we can even include them in our military target bank, because from our perspective, they are not media.
